page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; two italic paragraphs of text; centred "FINIS." and a woodcut ornament below; signature "Ii j" at the left foot; catchword "INDEX" at the right foot. No margin notes.

l.i: Et hæc quidem hactenus curiosè fortasse nimis: sed non sine
In Prologis, non est quod eandem quis à me diligentiam
requirat: Nam & meræ[?] alio meæ vocant, & in iis nihil
adeo dignum notatione visum est. Hoc solum monebo,
proponi cos Iustinos, in omnibus libris nostris praterquam
in Uno P. Pithœi, in quo sub titulo argumen-

page.notes: The woodcut ornament between "FINIS." and the signature carries no text. The "Ii j" signature and the "INDEX" catchword are read from the foot of the page. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "meræ" and the line "alio meæ" may be misprinted. Lines of the scan's left edge (neighbouring page) and the shelf mark at the lower right were left out.
